title: Fish Audio raises $52M seed to build AI voice models for creators and enterprises
slides: Can AI truly clone any voice in seconds?
Fish Audio just raised $52M for it.
Their models capture emotion, not just tone.
Creators now generate voiceovers without studios.
Test it on your own content today.
thread_text:
1. Can emotion be cloned?

Fish Audio just raised $52M to let AI capture not just tone, but the emotional weight behind any voice.

2. No studio required

Creators now generate full voiceovers from a browser. The hardware barrier is gone.

3. From seconds to finished track

Upload a clip—the model extracts pitch, pace, and feeling. Then type what you want said.

4. Who controls your voice?

If a 10-second sample can replicate you, what stops anyone from doing it without consent?

5. Test it on your own content today.

Record a 10-second clip of yourself speaking. Upload it to Fish Audio and type a sentence you never said. Does the result fool you?

Fish Audio raised fifty-two million dollars.

Test it on your own content today.

instagram.caption:
A $52 million bet says yes. Fish Audio’s new AI models can capture the emotion in your voice, not just the sound of it.

Upload a 10-second clip—the system extracts your pitch, pace, and feeling. Then you type a sentence you never said, and it speaks for you.

No studio, no mic, no actor needed. Voiceovers now happen in a browser. Any creator can generate audio from a text prompt.

If a 10-second sample can replicate you, who controls your voice once it's out there? 🎙️⚡🔊
